sentences.en: woman : Jack, I'm thinking of taking the kids to the seaside on a surfing holiday this summer and I wanted to ask your advice – as I know you're such an expert.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 杰克，我正考虑今年夏天带孩子们去海边度过一个冲浪假期，想听听你的建议——毕竟我知道你可是这方面的专家。

sentences.en: jack : Well, I don't know about that, but yes, I've done a bit of surfing over the years.
sentences.zh: JACK: 呃，我可不敢当什么专家，不过确实这些年断断续续冲过几次浪。

sentences.en: I'd thoroughly recommend it.
sentences.zh: 我非常推荐这种度假方式。

sentences.en: I think it's the kind of holiday all the family can enjoy together .
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是全家人都能一起享受的假期类型。

sentences.en: The thing about surfing is that it's great for all ages and all abilities.
sentences.zh: 冲浪的好处在于，它适合所有年龄段和各种水平的人。

sentences.en: My youngest started when he was only three!
sentences.zh: 我最小的孩子三岁就开始学了！

sentences.en: woman : Wow!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哇！

sentences.en: But it's quite physically demanding, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 但这对体力要求挺高的，对吧？

sentences.en: I've heard you need to be pretty fit .
sentences.zh: 我听说你得有相当好的体能才行。

sentences.en: jack : Yes.
sentences.zh: JACK: 是的。

sentences.en: You'll certainly learn more quickly and won't tire as easily.
sentences.zh: 你肯定学得更快，而且不容易感到疲劳。

sentences.en: woman : Well – that should be OK for us.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯——那对我们来说应该没问题。

sentences.en: You've been surfing a few times in Ireland, haven't you?
sentences.zh: 你在爱尔兰冲过几次浪，对吧？

sentences.en: jack : Yes.
sentences.zh: JACK: 对。

sentences.en: There's some great surfing there, which people don't always realise.
sentences.zh: 那里有不少很棒的冲浪点，只是人们往往没意识到这一点。

sentences.en: woman : And which locations would you recommend? – there seem to be quite a few .
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那你推荐哪些地点呢？——看起来选择还挺多的。

sentences.en: jack : Yes, there are loads.
sentences.zh: JACK: 是啊，选择非常多。

sentences.en: Last year we went to County Donegal.
sentences.zh: 去年我们去了多尼戈尔郡。

sentences.en: There are several great places to surf there.
sentences.zh: 那里有好几个绝佳的冲浪地点。

sentences.en: woman : What about in County Clare?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 克莱尔郡呢？

sentences.en: I read that's also really good for surfing.
sentences.zh: 我读到那里也很适合冲浪。

sentences.en: jack : Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: JACK: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: I've been there a few times.
sentences.zh: 我去过好几次。

sentences.en: Most people go to Lahinch.
sentences.zh: 大多数人都会去莱欣奇。

sentences.en: My kids love it there.
sentences.zh: 我孩子特别喜欢那儿。

sentences.en: The waves aren't too challenging and the town is very lively.
sentences.zh: 那里的海浪难度不太高，而且小镇氛围非常活跃。

sentences.en: woman : Are there good hotels there?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那边有不错的酒店吗？

sentences.en: jack : Yes – some very nice ones and there are also a few basic hostels and campsites.
sentences.zh: JACK: 有——有些非常棒的酒店，另外还有几家基础型青年旅舍和露营地。

sentences.en: It's great if you need lessons as the surf schools are excellent.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要上课，那里就更理想了，因为冲浪学校非常出色。

sentences.en: woman : Sounds good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: jack : Yes and there's lots to see in the area – like those well-known cliffs – …
sentences.zh: JACK: 是啊，而且当地还有很多景点可看——比如那些著名的悬崖……

sentences.en: I've forgotten the name of them …
sentences.zh: 我一时想不起它们的名字了……

sentences.en: woman : Oh don't worry – I can look them up.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦别担心，我可以自己查一下。

sentences.en: jack : I've also been surfing in County Mayo, which is less well-known for surfing, but we had a really good time.
sentences.zh: JACK: 我还在梅奥郡冲过浪，虽然那里不太以冲浪闻名，但我们玩得非常尽兴。

sentences.en: That was a few years ago when the kids were younger.
sentences.zh: 那是几年前的事了，当时孩子们还小一些。

sentences.en: There's a good surf school at Carrowniskey beach.
sentences.zh: 卡罗尼斯基海滩有一家不错的冲浪学校。

sentences.en: woman : How do you spell that?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那个名字怎么拼？

sentences.en: jack : C-A-double R-O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y woman : OK.
sentences.zh: JACK: C-A-双R-O-W-N-I-S-K-E-Y。WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: jack : I put the kids into the surf camp they run during the summer for 10–16 year olds.
sentences.zh: JACK: 我把孩子们送进了他们暑期举办的冲浪营，面向10至16岁的青少年。

sentences.en: woman : Oh right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，明白了。

sentences.en: How long was that for?
sentences.zh: 那次持续了多久？

sentences.en: jack : Three hours every day for a week.
sentences.zh: 杰克：每天三小时，持续一周。

sentences.en: It was perfect – they were so tired out after that.
sentences.zh: 那简直完美——孩子们之后累坏了。

sentences.en: woman : I can imagine.
sentences.zh: 女士：我能想象。

sentences.en: jack : One thing we did while the kids were surfing was to rent some kayaks to have a look around the bay which is nearby.
sentences.zh: 杰克：孩子们冲浪时，我们做的一件事是租了几艘皮划艇，在附近的海湾转了一圈。

sentences.en: It's really beautiful.
sentences.zh: 那里真的很美。

sentences.en: woman : Oh, I'd love to do that.
sentences.zh: 女士：哦，我真想试试。

sentences.en: woman : Now the only time I went to Ireland it rained practically every day.
sentences.zh: 女士：我唯一一次去爱尔兰，几乎天天都在下雨。

sentences.en: jack : Mmm yes – that can be a problem – but you can surf in the rain, you know.
sentences.zh: 杰克：嗯，是啊——这可能是个问题——但你知道，下雨天也能冲浪。

sentences.en: woman : It doesn't have the same appeal, somehow.
sentences.zh: 女士：不知怎的，那样就少了几分吸引力。

sentences.en: jack : Well, the weather's been fine the last couple of years when I've been there, but actually, it tends to rain more in August than in the spring or autumn.
sentences.zh: 杰克：嗯，过去几年我去的时候天气一直不错；不过实际上，八月的降雨量通常比春季或秋季更多。

sentences.en: September's my favourite month because the water is warmer then.
sentences.zh: 九月是我最喜欢的月份，因为那时海水更暖和。

sentences.en: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 Audioscripts woman : The only problem is that the kids are back to school then.
sentences.zh: 更多雅思干货，添加教主微信：519690129 听力原文 女士：唯一的问题是，那时孩子们已经返校上课了。

sentences.en: jack : I know.
sentences.zh: 杰克：我知道。

sentences.en: But one good thing about Irish summers is that it doesn't get too hot.
sentences.zh: 但爱尔兰夏季的一个好处是，天气不会太热。

sentences.en: The average temperature is about 19 degrees and it usually doesn't go above degrees.
sentences.zh: 平均气温约为19摄氏度，通常不会超过这个温度。

sentences.en: woman : That sounds alright.
sentences.zh: 女士：听起来还不错。

sentences.en: Now what about costs?
sentences.zh: 那么费用方面呢？

sentences.en: jack : Surfing is a pretty cheap holiday really – the only cost is the hire of equipment.
sentences.zh: 杰克：冲浪其实是一种相当便宜的度假方式——唯一的花费就是租用装备。

sentences.en: You can expect to pay a daily rate of about 30 euros for the hire of a wetsuit and board – but you can save about 40 euros if you hire by the week.
sentences.zh: 租用一套潜水服和冲浪板，每天大约需支付30欧元；但如果按周租赁，可节省约40欧元。

sentences.en: woman : That's not too bad.
sentences.zh: 女士：这还不算太贵。

sentences.en: jack : No.
sentences.zh: 杰克：是啊。

sentences.en: It's important to make sure you get good quality wetsuits – you'll all get too cold if you don't.
sentences.zh: 重要的是确保租到高质量的潜水服——否则大家都会觉得太冷。

sentences.en: And make sure you also get boots.
sentences.zh: 还要确保同时租到潜水靴。

sentences.en: They keep your feet warm and it's easier to surf with them on too.
sentences.zh: 它们能让你的双脚保持温暖，而且穿着它们冲浪也更容易。

sentences.en: woman : OK.
sentences.zh: 女士：好的。

sentences.en: Well, thanks very much …
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢……
